One incident: Railway's October 21, 2026 disclosure that an unauthorized party may have accessed customer environment variables and decrypted some of them. The from-story is a single beyondmachines.net event (2026-10-23T12:01Z) headlined 'Railway Discloses Secret Exposure Incident Linked to AI Hijacking Campaign'. The into-story is the canonical Railway incident: 11 events from blog.railway.com (the primary 'Security Disclosure: Wednesday October 21st'), thehackernews.com, bleepingcomputer.com, cyberupdates365.com, thecybersecguru.com and others; it owns the analysis and the CTI record, and both the 2026-10-23 and 2026-10-24 digests reference it. The beyondmachines event describes the same Oct 21 Railway env-var disclosure and the same AI-inference-provider attack pattern; it is a single-event shell with no analysis, CTI record or digest link, so it redirects to the canonical.
